title: JGates ASVS review ledger
description: evidence/asvs-review/requirements-ledger.json of a Semantic run of the method asvs-review: one answer per requirement the run reviewed, by id only (never the requirement text). examined: the files and lines the model read, and either no violation found in what was read or the Semantic findings it raised; not-examinable: why the source cannot answer it (a running system, a person, or code outside the scope). The ASVS coverage map counts an examined answer only when the run finished, the ledger is valid and every file reference names a file of the workspace; anything else counts for nothing.

requirements.description: One answer per requirement id; an id appears once.

unit.description: The review unit of the run that answered (a chapter id such as V6).

references.description: The files and lines read, relative to the workspace root with forward slashes.

outcome.description: examined: no-violation-found (no violation found in what was read) or finding (the Semantic findings named in findings).

findings.description: The fingerprints of the Semantic findings of the run this answer raised.

reason.description: not-examinable: running-system (it needs a running system), person (it needs a person: a document, a process, an operational setting) or outside-scope (it needs code outside the reviewed scope).
